mathematical_scope: positive-weight ordered binary affine BRC auxiliary model; grade-conditioned source survival; no native X6 theorem
theorem: For common positive constants alpha0,J0,K and all n>=1, J0<=j<n, 0<j/n<=alpha0: |log[C[n,j]/binom(n,j)]+2j^2/n+3j^3/n^2|<=K(j^4/n^3+j^2/n^2+1/j). Hence sqrt(n)<<j<<n yields log survival = -2j^2/n-3j^3/n^2+o(j^3/n^2).
proof_mechanism: uniform isolated rational dominant pole near u=0
all-angle Fourier contraction with strength n*u comparable to j
Gaussian saddle coefficient with uniform relative O(1/j)
limitations: The constants are existence/absolute/uniform but not numerically optimized
